specs: Target species include Atlantic Sailfish, Black Grouper, Mahi Mahi, Mutton Snapper, Red Snapper, Wahoo, Swordfish, Yellowtail Amberjack, and Blacktip Shark.

quotes.author: Teresa Thompson
quotes.text: Captain Chris was great, knowledgeable, fun and awesome with our kids! Nice boat, great driver! He fillet and bagged all of our fish! An all around fabulous trip!

Chris was fantastic from start to finish. He was friendly, attentive, and clearly knew what he was doing. He moved us around to different spots and switched up techniques so we could stay on the fish, and it paid off with some great mahi and barracuda. He was especially great with my 11-year-old son, keeping him engaged, teaching him, and making sure he was having fun the entire trip. You could tell he truly cared about giving us a memorable experience. We had an awesome day on the water and would highly recommend Chris for anyone wanting a great fishing charter in Miami.
